verdict.rationale: A live llms.txt exists at developer.konghq.com, which hosts the Insomnia docs. But it is a Kong-wide index: the visible excerpt names Kong Gateway, Konnect, AI Gateway and Mesh, not Insomnia. A probe of the Insomnia markdown docs root (insomnia/.md) returned 404, though individual Insomnia pages are cited at .md URLs. Missing for 10: confirmation that the llms.txt indexes Insomnia content, an Insomnia-specific llms.txt or agent-oriented docs section, a working Insomnia docs markdown root, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
